Decent
Aug 2019 • Friends
We stopped here after shopping at the Russian market, it was a cute, open air restaurant with very friendly staff. We ordered the pork ribs and the grilled chicken with sticky rice, both came out very quick and was more than enough food for me and my friend. The food was very tasty, with the sticky rice being my favorite as it had a coconut taste to it I’m not sure if there was actually coconut in it. The grilled chicken with a tad bit salty that I preferred but still good. I would recommend this place to people as it’s a good location to stop and grab a bite at their finding great deals at the Russian market.

Shocking Service
Dec 2018 • Solo
After walking for so long looking for a place they would take credit card, i walked in this place and asked if they would take credit card. They said yes, I sat down and they gave me a menú. I was so thirsty for walking for so long and i was expecting like in the States they would ask right away if i want to start with something to drink. They didn’t ask.. Anyway I was ready to order and they kept talking loud and laughing in the back of the restaurant, I kept looking at all of them any one that i would catch their eye so I can flag them down....but they were all ignoring me completely unaware that they forgot me. I keep thinking this is just my foreign prospective. The restaurant was semi empty only 3 tables occupied. I noticed a guy in a far table got up and grab some napkins from the table next to me. In a way i was relieved because coming from the states i thought they were just being racist because i am not Asian but then I realised the service in this restaurant is horrible. Here is a guy getting up from his table to grab napkins because a restaurant with a staff of 8 or 10 can’t service on their few coustumers. I mean really??
After 10 or 15 munutes i had enough and i pulled out my phone and started recording them. I figured they would noticed me recording them and they would change their attitude but it worked the opposite. One waiter sat across from me and pulled out his phone and started to text. Other guy started to eat something behind the register. It was as if they were performing for me. I got it all on video!
Certainly Vietnam has a different costumer service ethics than the U.S.A. The video will be posted on YouTube soon.
